name: just-inspector
description: Standalone runtime inspector UI for Godot / Bevy games — JSON WebSocket protocol, Vue 3 UI, browser + VS Code packaging.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @just-inspector/protocol && npm run build -w @just-inspector/client && npm run build -w @just-inspector/inspector-ui && npm run build -w just-inspector-web && npm run build -w just-inspector-vscode
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @just-inspector/protocol && npm run build -w @just-inspector/client && npm run build -w @just-inspector/inspector-ui
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client/tsconfig.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p packages/inspector-ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/vscode-extension/webview/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mock-server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/vscode-extension/tsconfig.json
